entry.title: discoDSP Updates Vertigo, Discovery Pro, and Bliss
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

discoDSP has released software updates for its Vertigo synthesizer, Discovery Pro, and Bliss sampler. Vertigo 5.4 introduces per-voice LFOs, MPE support, and a Keep Section to preserve modulation and effects setups across program changes. Bliss 3.22 adds support for importing third-party sampler formats via ConvertWithMoss and provides backward compatibility for Bliss 1 and 2 projects. Discovery Pro 9.2 adds HDR support on Windows and enables direct disk playback for Bliss and Corona wave banks.

These updates are provided free of charge to existing customers of the respective product versions. The releases focus on expanding synthesis capabilities, improving file interoperability between different software versions, and streamlining sample and wave bank management.

entry.title: Ueberschall Releases Looptool Inspire Loop Library
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

Ueberschall has released Looptool Inspire, a 11.5 GB loop library designed for the Elastik Player. The collection features over 4,200 loops spanning R&B, Hip Hop, Soul, Jazz, LoFi, Pop, and electronic genres, all engineered to be 100% compatible with one another for seamless arrangement.

entry.title: Fanan Team Releases Domina Free MIDI Arpeggiator Plugin
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

Domina is a free, seeded MIDI arpeggiator that generates complex, chord-responsive patterns using six-digit seeds. It produces millions of unique arpeggios by combining various idiom settings, pattern lengths, and octave ranges. The plugin outputs MIDI only, intended to drive third-party virtual instruments.

The software includes 20 genre idioms—such as Metal, Disco, and House—and features adjustable controls for rhythm, melodic contour, and motif complexity. It is available for Windows (VST3, CLAP) and macOS (VST3, AU, CLAP) as a universal binary for Apple Silicon and Intel.

entry.title: Thenatan Releases 8008 Sub Bass Shaper Plugin
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

Thenatan has released 8008, an all-in-one plugin designed to shape 808 and sub bass frequencies within the 30–150Hz range. The tool utilizes seven simultaneous processors, including band-split transient shaping, sub-fundamental boosting, eight saturation modes, compression, phase-perfect mono bass conversion, a lo-fi character stage, and a brickwall limiter.

Compatible with macOS (Apple Silicon native) and Windows, the plugin supports VST2, VST3, and AU formats and includes 88 factory presets. It features zero-latency processing and zero-CPU bypass for inactive stages. An introductory price of $8.08 is offered for the first 72 hours of release before the product returns to its regular price of $59.50.

entry.title: Hardwave Studios Releases WettBoi Reverb and Delay Plugin
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

WettBoi is a reverb and delay plugin with an integrated sidechain ducker, designed for hardstyle, rawstyle, and hardcore production. The tool allows reverb and delay tails to be attenuated against a kick drum using the plugin input or an external sidechain, eliminating the need for a separate bus.

The reverb section offers four algorithms—Room, Hall, Plate, and Spring—alongside controls for pre-delay, decay, damping, and stereo width. The delay section includes independent L/R timing, feedback, and LFO modulation. It is available in VST3 and CLAP formats for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with an introductory price of EUR 19.99.

Parish Audio has released Aethon, a granular transformation effect for Windows and macOS. The plugin captures incoming audio in real time and breaks it into grains that can be repositioned, scattered, reversed, or smoothed to create evolving textures, rhythmic pulses, and atmospheric movement.

entry.title: EDM Producers Call Out AI-Generated Music Passed Off as Human Art
entry.content:
Techmeme | theverge.com

Electronic dance music producers are identifying and exposing AI-generated tracks presented as human-made. As generative tools like Suno enable users to create songs with minimal effort, artists such as Max “H4RRIS” Harris and Nihil Young are calling out 'AI slop' to protect the authenticity of the genre and the livelihoods of human creators.

The movement responds to a growing culture of mistrust fueled by audio artifacts like vocal stuttering and persistent hissing. While AI music has achieved mainstream success on TikTok and the Billboard charts, producers argue that generative tools threaten human artistry and the clarity of musical styles.

entry.title: mfkne Releases PUNCHDUST Free Plugin
entry.content:
KVR Audio | kvraudio.com | source

PUNCHDUST is a free VST3 character dynamics and texture plugin for macOS and Windows. It integrates transient shaping, digital and analog textures, upward compression, and frequency balancing to modify audio character.

Four controls define the plugin: PUNCH for attack enhancement, DUST for 5-bit digital crackle and analog hiss, SQUEEZE for parallel upward compression, and TILT for frequency balancing. It utilizes a 48-sample lookahead and processes a wet signal to ensure the original dry signal remains untouched.
